guide_design_audit.meaning: Gene-pair design/replicate coverage only; no per-donor guide-target genotype check

planning_pilot.meaning: rough planning only; 13 EUR comparator lines do not estimate AFR donor variability

inference.interval: Bonferroni-adjusted percentile interval; resample cell lines within ancestry, preserving repeated line appearances across blocks

protocol.matching_scope: each retained pair appears in at least one line per ancestry group; complete-case sensitivity requires every line in a block
protocol.primary_metric: equal-block mean of equal-cell-line fitness-balanced AUROC
protocol.secondary_metric: equal-block mean of equal-cell-line precision at 10 measured pairs
protocol.status: retrospective protocol written after the SLB-1.3 test readout; prospective template for new donors
